summary: Strive, Inc. filed an amendment to its prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to add five new sales agents and increase the maximum aggregate offering of its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock (SATA) from $500M to $2.6B under an at-the-market offering program. As of June 2, 2026, the company had already sold 3,263,908 shares for gross proceeds of ~$326.3M. The last reported sale price was $97.32. Agents receive up to 3.0% commission. This is a routine shelf takedown/ATM program update with no special-situation event.
